caption: The drawing features a single round, shallow dish with intricate painted patterns and its side profile depicted below. The dish has a scalloped or zigzag edge and is decorated with green as the dominant color, interspersed with black, yellow, and brown accents. The interior of the dish is painted with a central four-pointed star-like design, outlined in black and filled with dotted patterns in yellow and green. Radiating outward from the center are four elongated almond-shaped elements in yellow, brown, and black, each framed with curved brown and black forms. The background around the central motif is green, with stylized yellow wavy lines filling the space between the points. The rim of the dish is decorated with concentric bands: one thin dark band, followed by a yellow band with undulating red lines, and a final outermost brown band matching the color of the dish’s visible edge. The separate side profile drawing below shows the dish as a reddish-brown, shallow bowl with a sawtooth-patterned rim. The artwork is presented on a cream-colored background.
title: Pa. German Dish
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
